```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(gt)
library(webshot2)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  message  = FALSE,
  warning  = FALSE,
  echo     = TRUE,
  include  = TRUE,
  eval     = TRUE,
  comment  = ""
)

```


# Ethograms

```{r include=FALSE}
gorilla <- tribble(
  ~Category,               ~Behavior,                         ~Definition,
  "Inactive",              "Standing",                        "Animal is upright with weight supported by legs and not performing another behavior listed.",
  "Inactive",              "Sitting",                         "Animal is seated with weight supported on buttocks and not performing another behavior listed.",
  "Inactive",              "Lying",                           "Animal is lying with weight supported on side, back, or stomach and not performing another behavior listed.",
  "Inactive",              "Vertical clinging",               "Animal is stationary and holding onto a vertical support with weight supported by hands and/or feet.",
  "Inactive",              "Hanging",                         "Animal is stationary and holding onto a horizontal support with weight supported by hands and/or feet with body suspended below support.",
  "Inactive",              "Other Inactive",                  "Animal is stationary and not engaged in an active behavior listed.",
  "Feed /Forage /Drink",   "Foraging",                        "Animal is working to acquire a food item.",
  "Feed /Forage /Drink",   "Browsing",                        "Animal is stripping or plucking leaves from a branch, either using their mouth or hands.",
  "Feed /Forage /Drink",   "Extractive Foraging",             "Animal is manipulating an object to extract a food item (e.g., puzzle feeder, ice block).",
  "Feed /Forage /Drink",   "Substrate Foraging",              "Animal is visually scanning or manipulating loose substrate to search for food items or moving ≥1 body’s length to acquire food.",
```

```{r include=FALSE}
undesirable <- tribble(
  ~Behavior,                  ~Definition,
  "Pacing",                   "Animal is walking in a repetitive manner along a fixed path without an apparent goal or function (≥3 loops).",
  "Stereotypic swimming",     "Animal is swimming in a repetitive fixed-path manner without an apparent goal or function (≥3 loops).",
  "Repetitive Licking/Gnawling","Animal repeatedly licking or gnawing a non-food object (wood, metal, concrete).",
  "Regurgitation/Reingestion","Animal voluntarily regurgitating and then consuming that material.",
  "Coprophagy",               "Animal is ingesting feces.",
  "Urophagy",                 "Animal is ingesting urine.",
  "Hair/Feather plucking",    "Repetitive over-grooming resulting in hair or feather loss.",
  "Body/Hair Pulling",        "Pulling on body parts or hair in a non-goal-directed manner.",
  "Swaying/rocking",          "Stationary but moving body or head in repetitive sideways/forward motion.",
  "Self-biting",              "Chewing on a body part repetitively, often causing wounds.",
  "Tongue Play",              "Tongue moving repeatedly in/out (e.g., “firehose” flopping) not for feeding.",
  "Food Play",                "Moving food around mouth non-feeding directed.",
  "Wall Swimming",            "Swimming repetitively against an exhibit barrier.",
  "Head Rolling/Tossing",     "Moving and rolling head in fixed stereotyped manner.",
  "Other Undesirable",        "Any other stereotypic or self-injurious behavior."
)
```

```{r include=FALSE}
sealion <- tribble(
  ~Category,             ~Code, ~Behavior,                         ~Definition,
  "Inactive",            "LNG",  "Lying",                           "Animal is lying with weight supported on side, back, or stomach and not performing another behavior listed.",
  "Inactive",            "FLT",  "Floating",                        "Animal is stationary and suspended in water.",
  "Inactive",            "OTI",  "Other Inactive",                  "Animal is stationary and not engaged in an active behavior listed.",
  "Feed /Forage /Drink", "FDG",  "Feeding",                         "Animal is chewing and ingesting food items or manipulating a food item for the purpose of feeding.",
  "Locomotion",          "TLO",  "Terrestrial Locomotion",          "Animal is moving at least one body’s length in non-stereotypical manner on land.",
  "Locomotion",          "DVF",  "Diving (Surface)",                "Animal is leaping off of ledge into water to travel a distance greater than one body's length.",
  "Locomotion",          "DVB",  "Diving (Submerged)",              "Animal is fully submerged and swimming a distance greater than one body's length at a steep downward angle.",
  "Locomotion",          "SWI",  "Swimming",                        "Animal is propelling itself through water at least a distance greater than one body's length.",
  "Undesirable",         "UND",  "Undesirable",                     "Animal is performing an undesirable behavior, including stereotypic and self-injurious behaviors.",
  "Other Solitary",      "KIN",  "Keeper Interaction",              "Animal is directly interacting with keepers, either performing trained behaviors in the context of a training session or engaged in an informal manner, including handling, playing, or inspecting.",
  "Other Solitary",      "KIT",  "Keeper Interaction (Training Sesh)", "Animal performs trained behaviors during interaction with a keeper, in the context of a training session.",
  "Other Solitary",      "VOC",  "Vocalization",                    "Animal is producing sounds through intentional vibration of air for the purpose of communication (may involve vocal cords, stridulation of body parts, vibration of air sacs, or other taxa-specific adaptations).",
  "Other Solitary",      "SOL",  "Other Solitary",                  "Animal is performing a solitary behavior not previously listed, including exploratory behavior, self-maintenance, scent marking, solitary play, elimination, human interaction.",
  "Social",              "AFL",  "Affiliative Behavior",            "Animal performs any non-sexual affiliative behavior, including grooming a social partner, playing, or social greetings.",
  "Social",              "CAG",  "Contact Aggression",              "Animal physically attacks another individual, including biting, batting, or kicking.",
  "Social",              "NAG",  "Non-contact Aggression",          "Animal performs non-contact aggressive behavior towards another individual, including threat displays or chasing.",
  "Social",              "OAG",  "Other Agonistic Behavior",        "Animal performs any aggressive behavior, either with or without contact, or any dominance related behavior.",
  "Other",               "OTH",  "Other",                           "Animal is performing any behavior not listed [Note: please specify the behavior category and make a comment to describe behavior].",
  "Not Visible",         "BOB",  "Behavior Obscured",               "The behavior of the animal cannot be determined but the location of the animal is known.",
  "Not Visible",         "ANV",  "Animal Not Visible",              "The animal is completely not visible and its location is unknown."
)
```

```{r sea-lions-ethogram}
sealion_eth <- sealion %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "Category", rowname_col = "Code") %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "gray") %>%
  tab_style(style = list(
    cell_text(weight    = "bold", 
              transform = "uppercase", 
              size      = "small", 
              style     = "oblique",
              stretch   = "expanded")
  ),
  locations = cells_row_groups()) %>%
  tab_style(style = list(
    cell_text(weight    = "bolder", 
              transform = "uppercase")
  ),
  locations = cells_stub()) %>%
  tab_style(style = list(
    cell_text(weight    = "bold")
  ),
  locations = cells_body(columns = "Behavior")) %>%
  tab_header("Sea Lion Ethogram") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "left", style = "oblique", weight = "bold"), 
            locations = cells_title()) %>%
  rm_spanners()
```

```{r feline-ethogram}
  ),
  locations = cells_body(columns = "Behavior")) %>%
  tab_header("Feline Ethogram") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "left", style = "oblique", weight = "bold"), 
            locations = cells_title()) %>%
  rm_spanners()
```

```{r ungulate-ethogram}
ungulate_eth <- ungulate %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "Category", rowname_col = "Code") %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "gray") %>%
  tab_style(style = list(
    cell_text(weight    = "bold", 
              transform = "uppercase", 
              size      = "small", 
              style     = "oblique",
              stretch   = "expanded")
  ),
  locations = cells_row_groups()) %>%
  tab_style(style = list(
    cell_text(weight    = "bolder", 
              transform = "uppercase")
  ),
  locations = cells_stub()) %>%
  tab_style(style = list(
    cell_text(weight    = "bold")
  ),
  locations = cells_body(columns = "Behavior")) %>%
  tab_header("Ungulate Ethogram") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "left", style = "oblique", weight = "bold"), 
            locations = cells_title()) %>%
  rm_spanners()
```

```{r}
scans <- tibble(
  Time            = sprintf("0:%02d:00", 1:20),
  `In/Out of Water` = rep("", 20),
  Behavior        = rep("", 20),
  Notes           = rep("", 20)
)

focal <- tibble(
  `Start Time` = rep("", 16),
  Behavior      = rep("", 16),
  Initiator     = rep("", 16),
  Recipient     = rep("", 16),
  `End Time`   = rep("", 16),
  Notes         = rep("", 16)
)

allocc <- tibble(
  `Start Time` = rep("", 14),
  Behavior      = rep("", 14),
  Species       = rep("", 14),
  `End Time`   = rep("", 14),
  Notes         = rep("", 14)
)

```

```{r}
scans_out <- scans %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "Time") %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 2, color = "gray") %>%
  tab_style(style = list(
    cell_text(size = "x-large")
  ),
  locations = cells_stub()) %>%
  tab_header("Sea Lion Observations") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "left", style = "oblique", weight = "bold"), 
            locations = cells_title()) %>%
  cols_width(
    `In/Out of Water` ~ px(100),
    Behavior ~ px(200),
    Notes ~ px(400)
  ) %>%
  cols_align("left")
scans_out

gtsave(scans_out, "data_scans.png")
```
